subject.title: Pack some of a named hold

question: After partial packing, should a reissued `stock.reserve` request carrying the original order-line quantity return the same partially packed ticket or be rejected unless it requests the remaining quantity?
rationale: The PR mutates the quantity used by the existing matching-hold contract, and the product decision ledger settles ticket lifecycle but not this reconciliation behavior.

options.title: Preserve original reservation matching
options.body: Retain the original requested quantity for matching so reissuing the same order-line reservation returns the partially packed ticket without another inventory mutation.

options.title: Define remaining quantity as the new contract
options.body: Keep the rejection for the original quantity and explicitly document and test that callers must reserve only the remaining quantity after partial packing.

recommendation.title: Preserve original reservation matching
recommendation.body: Retain the original requested quantity for matching so reissuing the same order-line reservation returns the partially packed ticket without another inventory mutation.

likelyOwner.reason: The ledger identifies Bobby as the authority for the affected packing-ticket semantics.
